profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, iOS at Tinder
profile.summary: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take. 🏀

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, iOS
positions.description:
• P2P team on the PayPal consumer application.
• Develop several highly-visible new features which drove up customer engagement and company revenue.
• Refactored and removed legacy code and adopt the latest standards provided by the Platform team.
• Work closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and developers from other teams.
• Help ramp up new hires and conduct interviews.
• Did some Python to help generate analytics events code from a .cvs file to be shared between iOS and Android.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Support, maintain and update new features and functionality for several of our live existing iOS, tvOS, and watchOS applications.
• Develop iOS applications under our product and solutions that includes indoor routing experience, push and local notifications and displaying data from our backend.
• Fix bugs that exist in the wild. Debug root causes and offer solutions.
• Work in an organized team oriented environment with Product Managers, Customer Success and cross-platform developers. Help Junior developers.
• Familiarize myself with the full technical stack of our solutions, Git, Fastlane and continuous integration such as Jenkins.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with Engineering, Product, and Support teams to design, own, and deliver on test plans for new features and functionality.
- Proficient in writing automated test scripts.
- Experience in regression for iOS, Android, SDKs, web, server, and cloud offerings to ensure we are shipping a product we’re proud of.
- Identify bugs that exist in the wild and help prioritize fixes.
- Provide immediate feedback to product stakeholders and work with them to improve the product.

honors.title: Product MVP
honors.description:
- Made a huge impact on the Product QA Team
- Displays a deep analytical mind and thoroughness in all his testing
- Worked to become THE subject matter expert on SDKs and garnered respect from everyone on the team
- Most recently, stepped up as the solo lead QA on the mapping 3.0 SDK, a critical release for the SDK team and the company
honors.issuer: Issued by VP of Engineering · Jul 2016

projects.title: iOS Development
projects.description: I enjoy developing iOS applications in my free time and hope to explore this field more in future prospects.
